uncertainties.note: Rapid-fire combat/alert barks with untagged speakers on both the New Federation and Space Revolutionary Army sides. Translated at face value without assigning lines to a faction or inventing a speaker identity beyond what the source text itself states.

Untagged 'brother' exchange, read from later context (09966, 09970-09971) as the Frost brothers (Shagia/Olba) setting up the climax, but no name is written into these rows since the source gives none here.

Source says bare 'Nadesico' with no hull letter; not resolved to 'Nadesico C' since the source omits it, even though the scene (resource 6300, mission with Nadesico C per task briefing) suggests that reading.
'the Captain' kept as an unnamed title; likely Jamil (Freeden's captain, escorting Tiffa) given the Gundam X plot, but the source itself never names him, so no name was supplied.
